relationships.subject: HDAC4
relationships.evidence_quote: HDAC4 is a negative regulator of chondrocyte hypertrophy because it suppresses several chondrocyte-hypertrophy-related genes, including RUNX2 and MMP13, by inhibiting their promotor activities [60,63].

relationships.subject: Panobinostat
relationships.evidence_quote: The intra-articular administration of 2 or 10 µg of panobinostat (each group, n = 7) per week from the 6th to 17th week attenuates ACLT-induced nociceptive behaviors

key_findings: Intra-articular panobinostat reduced ACLT-induced allodynia, weight-bearing asymmetry and cartilage degeneration.
Panobinostat raised HDAC4 and lowered HDAC6, HDAC7, RUNX2 and MMP13 in cartilage.
